arxiv-1907-13588.title: TECHNIQUES AND RESULTS OF NEUTRAL LONG-LIVED PARTICLE SEARCHES IN ATLAS AND CMS IN LHC RUN 2
arxiv-1907-13588.creator: CLAUDIA-ELISABETH WULZ, for the ATLAS and CMS Collaborations
arxiv-1907-13588.description: Abstract Selected results of searches for neutral long-lived particles with displaced and delayed jets, trackless jets and emerging jets, as well as displaced muons, obtained with data recorded at a centre-of-mass energy of 13 TeV by the ATLAS and CMS Collaborations during LHC’s Run 2 are presented, as well as challenges and techniques.

arxiv-2208-08761.title: A NEW UNKNOTTING OPERATION FOR CLASSICAL AND WELDED LINKS
arxiv-2208-08761.creator: Danish Ali, Zhiqing Yang, Mohd Ibrahim Sheikh
arxiv-2208-08761.description: Abstract . An unknotting operation is a local change on knot diagrams. Any knot diagram can be transformed into a trivial unknot diagram by a series of unknotting operations plus some Reidemeister moves. Unknotting operations have significant importance in knot theory; they are used to study the complexity of knots and invariants of knots.

arxiv-2212-07325.title: Voltage-dependent first-principles simulation of insertion of chloride ions into Al/Al 2 O 3 interfaces using the Quantum Continuum Approximation
arxiv-2212-07325.creator: Quinn Campbell
arxiv-2212-07325.description: Abstract Experiments have shown that pitting corrosion can develop in aluminum surfaces at potentials > − 0.5 >-0.5 V relative to the standard hydrogen electrode (SHE). Until recently, the onset of pitting corrosion in aluminum has not been rigorously explored at an atomistic scale because of the difficulty of incorporating a voltage into density functional theory (DFT) calculations.

arxiv-2306-13278.title: Input-driven chaotic dynamics in vortex spin-torque oscillator
arxiv-2306-13278.creator: Yusuke Imai, Kohei Nakajima, Sumito Tsunegi, Tomohiro Taniguchi
arxiv-2306-13278.description: Abstract A new research topic in spintronics relating to the operation principles of brain-inspired computing is input-driven magnetization dynamics in nanomagnet. In this paper, the magnetization dynamics in a vortex spin-torque oscillator (STO) driven by a series of random magnetic field are studied through a numerical simulation of the Thiele equation.

arxiv-2506-09086.title: York’s Cavity Formalism and Quantum-Modified Thermodynamics of (2+1)D Black Holes
arxiv-2506-09086.creator: Prince A Ganai,, Nadeem Ul Islam, Nazir A Ganaie
arxiv-2506-09086.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Prince A Ganai,, Nadeem Ul Islam, Nazir A Ganaie. We investigate the thermodynamic behavior of ( 2 + 1 ) (2+1) -dimensional BTZ black holes using York’s cavity formalism, in which the black hole is enclosed within a finite-radius boundary held at a fixed temperature. This canonical ensemble construction enables the precise derivation of thermodynamic quantities such as temperature, energy, entropy, pressure, and heat capacity via the integral Euclidean path approach.

arxiv-2510-01450.title: Local Linear Attention: An Optimal Interpolation of Linear and Softmax Attention For Test-Time Regression
arxiv-2510-01450.creator: Yifei Zuo, Yutong Yin † \dagger, Zhichen Zeng, Ang Li ‡ \ddagger, Banghua Zhu ‡ \ddagger, Zhaoran Wang † \dagger
arxiv-2510-01450.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yifei Zuo, Yutong Yin † \dagger, Zhichen Zeng, Ang Li ‡ \ddagger, Banghua Zhu ‡ \ddagger, Zhaoran Wang † \dagger. Transformer architectures have achieved remarkable success in various domains. While efficient alternatives to Softmax Attention have been widely studied, the search for more expressive mechanisms grounded in theoretical insight—even at greater computational cost—has been relatively underexplored. In this work, we bridge this gap by proposing Local Linear Attention (LLA), a novel attention mechanism derived from nonparametric statistics through the lens of test-time regression.

arxiv-2511-01190.title: Analyzing the Power of Chain of Thought softmax through Memorization Capabilities
arxiv-2511-01190.creator: Lijia Yu, Xiao-Shan Gao, Lijun Zhang
arxiv-2511-01190.description: Abstract It has been shown that the chain of thought (CoT) can enhance the power of large language models (LLMs) to solve certain mathematical reasoning problems. However, the capacity of CoT is still not fully explored. As an important instance, the following basic question has not yet been answered: Does CoT expand the capability of transformers across all reasoning tasks?

pmc-13463024.description: Bird’s-eye view (BEV) radar-camera fusion is an economical and robust solution for 3D perception in autonomous driving. uslaw-usc-t49-s28101.title: 49 U.S.C. § 28101 — Rail police officers
uslaw-usc-t49-s28101.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s28101.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part E (Miscellaneous); Chapter 281 (Law Enforcement). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In General.— Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Transportation, a rail police officer who is directly employed by or contracted by a rail carrier and certified or commissioned as a police officer under the laws of a State may enforce the laws.
